sent.en: We are in the living room watching television.

note: f. An inside wall. A garden or town wall is un muro.

note: m. Spanish uses the one word for both.

sent.en: Can you pass me a towel?

sent.en: The rent is paid on the first of every month.

sent.en: The bank is two blocks away.

sent.en: Turn right at the traffic lights.

sent.en: The road to the coast is very beautiful.

sent.en: We went to an island near Cartagena.
